{{Top|leg}}
'''Lucogen''' was a gelatinous chemical catalyst that was a common ingredient in some [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] food pastes. Lucogen could be combined with the substance [[Lithium Magna]] to form a binary explosive and in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Popara Anjiliac Diresto]] was fed traces of the two chemicals during a banquet in [[Popara's penthouse|his penthouse]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], which caused him to explode.
